text: NARMA-10 is a 10th-order task: the summation term Σ y(t−k) for k=0..9 depends on the previous ___ consecutive values of y.
explanation: The sum runs over y(t), y(t−1), …, y(t−9): exactly 10 consecutive past values. This 10-step dependence is why the benchmark requires about 10 steps of memory.
